How We Build Around Them

We Design Around Your Customers

Highest-value buyer

Capture the Weekend Visitor

Trailhead Tanner buys big, decides on a phone, and never returns unless it's effortless. A dedicated "Visiting the Range" page and local SEO route trail, hunting and mine-view traffic straight to your menu.

Five of seven are 38+

Legible by Default

Larger type, 48px tap targets and AA contrast throughout, so Ray, Marlene and Carol never squint or mis-tap on a phone in the truck.

New and returning

Two Front Doors

Shop the Menu for buyers who know what they want; New Here? Start Here for first-timers. Nobody lands on the wrong page.

Occasion, not ailment

Compliant Navigation

Evening · Daytime · Low-Dose · Social · First-Time Friendly, the wayfinding Marlene and Carol need, with none of the health-claim risk Minnesota prohibits.

Platform & Sitemap

WordPress + Dutchie

LayerChoiceWhy
CMSWordPressPortable, blog-native, locally maintainable
Menu / checkoutDutchie embed on /shopCompliant checkout Dutchie handles; SEO toggle on. No API, dodges the 2026 Plus sunset.
Age gate + analyticsCustom overlay · GA4/GTMLighter; click-to-menu tracked as proxy conversion

Eleven Templates

T1

Home

Two-CTA hero → status bar → occasion & category tiles → featured → deals → posts → visit.

T2

Shop / Menu

Dutchie embed on /shop. Occasion row deep-links filtered states.

T7

Education Hub

Pillar + children: first-time, reading a label, formats, what's legal, dosing.

T8

About / Our Story

Iron Range framing, real staff, beats multi-state operators.

T9

Visit / Contact

Hours, map, directions from feeder towns, payment, price-context.

T11

Visiting the Range

Trail proximity + consumption law. Tanner's landing page.
